Summary: 10-year, 12 mills property tax for acquiring, constructing, improving,
maintaining and/or operating fire protection facilities and equipment for Sarepta
Fire Protection District No. 5, including paying the cost of obtaining water for fire
protection purposes.

contests.title: Member of School Board -- District V
Epps School District No.1 -- 4.47 Mills - SB - 5 Yrs.
contests.summary:
Epps School District No. 1 Proposition
(Millage Renewal)

Summary: 5 year, 4.47 mills property tax renewal of Epps School District No.
1 for constructing, improving, maintaining and repairing facilities, for purchase
and lease of property, for maintenance, replacement, repair and purchase of
equipment and to purchase institutional materials and supplies for Epps High
School.

contests.title: PW School District -- 11.43 Mills - SB - 10 Yrs.
contests.summary:
Parishwide School District Proposition
(Millage Renewal)

Summary: 10 year, 11.43 mills property tax renewal for constructing, improving,
maintaining and repairing facilities, for purchase and leasing of property, for
maintenance, replacement, repair and purchase of equipment and to purchase
materials and supplies, with the revenues to be divided between each school in
the Parishwide School District on a per pupil basis.

contests.title: Village of Pioneer -- COP Elected to Appointed-Mayor/BOA
contests.summary:
Village of Pioneer Proposition

Summary: Authority to appoint a marshal who shall be the chief of police of the Village
of Pioneer.

contests.summary:
Proposition No. 1
(Library Renewal)

Summary: 5 year, 5 mills property tax renewal for maintaining and supporting,
for acquiring sites, or erecting, or renovating buildings, or performing capital
improvements on existing buildings thereon or additions thereto, including
furniture, fixtures and equipment for the Winn Parish Library.

contests.summary:
Proposition No. 2
(Library Renewal)

the Winn Parish Library.

Road District #1 Proposition
(Millage Continuation)

Summary: 5 year, 2.02 mills property tax continuation for Road District #1 (in the
corporate limits of the City of Winnfield) for constructing, repairing and
maintaining streets and bridges.

contests.summary:

maintaining public roads and bridges.
